args.query: my generic TypeScript function widens literal types to string, how to keep literals with const type parameters

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: openapi-typescript generate types
results.summary: Generate TypeScript types from an inline OpenAPI 3.1 document with the openapi-typescript programmatic API using openapiTS and astToString, asserting generated interface members and path keys offline.

results.title: mime-types lookup
results.summary: Look up content-type from an extension and extension from a type with mime-types, asserting json, html, png and wasm plus the charset helper and graceful unknown handling, offline.

results.title: file-type buffer detection
results.summary: Detect PNG, PDF, ZIP and GIF from small in-memory magic byte buffers with file-type, asserting ext and mime, and undefined for plain text.

results.title: Fastify 5 + Zod 4 type provider for typed routes
results.summary: Use fastify-type-provider-zod so Zod 4 schemas validate requests, serialize responses and type handlers in Fastify 5.

results.title: preact render to string SSR
results.summary: Server-render preact components with preact-render-to-string, covering props, useState initial values, conditional output, keyed lists and dangerouslySetInnerHTML while asserting exact escaped HTML offline.

results.title: ts-morph code generation and AST codemods in memory
results.summary: Generate a typed TypeScript client module with ts-morph structures, type-check it with pre-emit diagnostics, and run codemods (cross-file rename, var to const, strip console.log) on an in-memory file system.

results.title: Runtime type checking with typeguard: @typechecked, check_type and generics
results.summary: Enforce annotations at runtime with typeguard: @typechecked functions, standalone check_type, TypeCheckError messages and bounded TypeVars, plus the FIRST_ITEM container gotcha.

results.title: magic-string sourcemap edits
results.summary: Overwrite, prependLeft, append and remove ranges in a source string with magic-string, generate a hires source map and verify positions with source-map-js SourceMapConsumer.originalPositionFor offline.

results.title: rapidfuzz extractOne and scorers for fuzzy string matching
results.summary: Pick the best candidate with process.extractOne, control matching with WRatio, partial and token scorers, and normalize messy input with utils.default_process.
